Grid members are not created as separate menu items (member_menu_items: 'none') except where the source document explicitly calls for a redirect/dedicated link (Escuela de Evangelización, handled as an alias).
Items marked 'Create and Parish will review' assigned content_source 'generate'.
Items marked 'Pull from website' assigned content_source 'pull'.
Items marked 'Link to...' / redirect instructions assigned type external_url with content_source 'redirect' and target 'TBD' where no explicit URL was given in the document.
'Incio | Home' assumed to be the site homepage; no explicit content instructions given, so content_source defaulted to 'generate'.

'School of Evangelization' top-level item treated as a standalone single_article page since the document gives no direct sub-items or content instructions for it, aside from being the referenced redirect target under Ministerio Liderazgo.

'Sacramentos | Sacraments' kept as a heading with individual single_article/external_url children (not collapsed into a category_grid) because each sacrament carries distinct, differentiated content instructions (forms, specific redirects, unique links) rather than being a uniform list of same-kind named entities.

Social Media Icons noted in the document are treated as a site-wide module outside the defined modules schema (toplinks/under_rotator) and are not included as structured module items; flagged in open_questions.
